items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: My first recording session was with Abby Bruner, that I can remember.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did you record with him? No. No, I never made no records. When was your first recording session, by the way?
My first recording session was with Abby Bruner, that I can remember. Yeah.
And did you make any more records until the 1940s?
